scope: Pinned production renderer A/B; identical frozen geometry and rendering quality. Offscreen output, no canvas-presentation/FPS qualification.

settings.order: Alternating baseline-first and candidate-first paired single frames; queues drained before each frame.
settings.timingIncludes: Scene uniforms/uploads, command encoding, submission and queue completion. Optional GPU timestamps cover real passes; timestamp resolution/readback excluded from wall timer.
settings.timingExcludes: Simulation stepping, initial resource allocation/compilation, screenshot readback, browser presentation.
settings.inputStreamUploadAccounting: inputStreamUploadedBytes excludes scene uniforms and visibility parameters; their CPU and queue-completed costs remain inside frame timing.

sources.compiler: TypeScript transpileModule ES2022; independent runtime dependency trees; no shader/source substitutions

provenance.browserCommandLineUnavailable: cdpSession.send: Protocol error (Browser.getBrowserCommandLine): Command line not returned because --enable-automation not set.

timedAdapterIdentityComparison.limitation: Only exposed identity fields can be compared; redacted physical device IDs remain unverified.

visibility.method: Independent float64 eight-corner clip-plane oracle. GPU conservative supersets allowed; missing eligible visible instances forbidden.

uncertainty.method: 1000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples; descriptive uncertainty for this run, not cross-device generalization.
